## Description
Briefly describe the change and the issue it resolves or feature it introduces.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Refactor / code health (no change in behavior)

## Checklist
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `bun run build` succeeds
- [ ] Follows SolidJS v2 reactivity rules (no prop destructuring, no React hooks)
- [ ] Zero secrets, `.env` values, or sensitive data committed
- [ ] Zero unsolicited test files (`*.test.ts`, `*.spec.ts`) per `AGENTS.md`
